coordinate_convention: region is x/y/w/h in arms atlas; pivot/anchors are region-local pixels. Keep source parts rigid: torso rotation plus rest_rotation, fixed uniform_scale. Shoulder roots bind base torso right_shoulder/left_shoulder; collar pivot binds base torso neck.
occlusion_contract: far_neutral stays behind the original torso; its shoulder root is covered by existing torso pixels.
near_neutral/near_strike remain in front of the independent sword, unchanged from the first two-state sample.

Only the independent shoulder texture supplies shoulder_collar. It contains one near-shoulder cloth fold and no collar, neck loop or chest panel. Its projected near_shoulder_cover matches the existing right shoulder location.
Base head/torso pixels and transforms remain unchanged; the shoulder fold must not cover the neck or face. Any visible hard seam or excessive patch fails visual review.
Independent sword remains bound to the unmodified near grip. No new gear or identity is implied.
candidate_notes: Only three entire arm layers plus one collar were generated; base atlas03 was neither edited nor regenerated.
Arm cutouts include continuous sleeve/elbow/forearm/wrist/hand; no separate elbow/wrist transforms.
All three arms use fixed 0.50 scale for initial assembly; collar 0.43. These are candidates from physical proportions and must be checked in two-pose composition.
No full six-pose bank, wounded/fallen arm variants, Main/registry entry, new event timing or world mutation.

near_strike rest_rotation compensates the two-state sample peak torso lean (public shoulder-hip [0.23,-0.31]) and measured source shoulder-to-grip direction, so the complete arm and independent blade point screen right at that chosen sample. This is a fixed pose variant, not a generic timing or arbitrary-pose solver.

One authorized final correction replaces only shoulder_collar with a dedicated third texture. The old four-part atlas, all three arm part dictionaries, base definition and base atlas remain byte-identical. The old whole-yoke candidate is preserved before this replacement; no source-patch collar experiment was performed.

The independent shoulder uses a transparent region that includes the neck-reference pivot [48,124]; all actual cloth pixels lie in [330,329,946,1005]. At fixed 0.14 scale, source cover anchor [705,445] is [91.98,44.94] pixels from base neck, matching base right_shoulder minus neck [92,45]. This is measured placement, not an art acceptance claim.

pose_registration.basis: Measured arm endpoints and existing public pose fixture; no world data edits.
